newsitem.title: RUSSIA: German chancellor in Moscow to meet Yeltsin.
newsitem.headline: German chancellor in Moscow to meet Yeltsin.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl arrived in Moscow on Saturday for talks with President Boris Yeltsin, who is resting and preparing for heart surgery later this month.
The two leaders, personal friends, were due to meet at a hunting lodge outside Moscow to discuss economic relations between Germany and Russia and international security issues.
It will be Yeltsin's first encounter with a Western head of government since he was elected on July 3 to a second four-year term in the Kremlin.

After arriving at Vnukovo airport, Kohl's delegation transferred to waiting helicopters which were due to take the visitors to Yeltsin's Rus residence in Zavidovo, about 100 km (60 miles) from Moscow.
German officials have said the visit is an informal affair with no urgent agenda.
Kohl is expected to give a news conference at about 1330 GMT, before his departure.
